en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing the monumental entrance of a large building with three grand horseshoe arches richly decorated in an ornate, Moorish-revival style. Tall columns support the arches, and intricate geometric window grilles fill the doorways. Several people stand and walk on the broad staircase in front of the building, and an early automobile is visible at the bottom of the steps. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center of the image.
